findingsDuringImplementation: macOS system tar adds AppleDouble/xattr entries; archive production now emits the five allowlisted files with tar-stream.
Read-only SQLite WAL opens leave sidecars; interrupted retry classifies them and completed verification normalizes only empty WAL sidecars.
Main-file hashes can miss newer committed WAL content; completed recovery explicitly refuses a nonempty WAL.
Rejected tar entry streams need an error owner; malformed-input checks now settle without post-test uncaught errors.
One test needed foreign-key enforcement disabled to manufacture a corrupt fixture; ciphertext rejection can originate in age or downstream decompression.
pnpm sandbox store-location checks refused automatic installation; cached dependency addition used the existing host store and subsequent checks used installed binaries.
limits: Recovery success is quarantined, with no serving permit or generic promotion command. Operators still decide continuity versus explicit fresh setup/import with possible writing loss.
No automatic reconciliation, off-host commit log, second node, schema migration or writer failover was added.
Archive validation, session reset, interruption and SIGKILL checks used disposable state; no personal or deployed data was restored.
B2 regressions used a controlled protocol fixture; no actual bucket, identity-custody rehearsal, deployment or image publication.
Process-crash checks are not host power-loss durability evidence; plaintext recovery directories are not forensically erased.
The production runtime rehearsal is network-disabled and uses generated keys in tmpfs. It exercises the actual pruned-dependency image.
Release qualification and the deferred personal history-management walkthrough remain paused.
